name: post_st_level_coverage_v1
purpose: Separate probability-level calibration from q2 feature coverage; no combined arm or reference promotion.
mtry_note: mtry stays75; actual pre-q-limit candidates rise from25 to75. This intentionally increases search coverage/cost, not an equal-computation comparison.
current_forests: Six frozen shallow_parent models; same old-C83 inputs, next-open origin, first termination versus recovery, announcement dates,24-calendar-month train cap; inherited PROVISIONAL PIT limitations.

calibration.unit: One three-seed ensemble calibrator per year and horizon;4 fits. Never calibrate and wide83 together.
calibration.temporal_rule: Latest TWO calendar-entry cohorts whose full horizon ends strictly before Jan1 of outer year; select by origin+horizon, NEVER by whether the event is known. All rows kept; require complete endpoints for this declared design, abort otherwise.
calibration.oof: Reuse unit-weight baseline historical rolling forests fitted strictly before each validation entry year; predict held-out companies. No in-sample calibration. Includes historical cohorts from withdrawn temporal study only as immutable unit-weight artifacts, not adoption of its selected policy.
calibration.mapping: Fnew_k(t,x)=c_k*g_H(t)+b_k*F_k(t,x); c>=0; time-constant .5<=b<=4; fewer than10 target-cause events fixes that cause slope to1. No gate manipulation or extra cohorts.
calibration.shape: g_H=outer-training pooled-event AJ normalized at day365/730, held1 after that day. Origin0. Assumed offset shape, not claimed calibrated at intermediate times.
calibration.objective: Joint two-cause squared probability loss at the given calendar horizon plus20/n times mean squared change from identity; no hyperparameter selection.
calibration.constraints: Terminal convex hull of average independent tree-leaf choices (Minkowski sum) gives an outer bound for all x. c1+c2+b dot vertex<=1, including all observed OOF probability vectors. Global all-time certificate follows from nonnegative monotone offsets and positive slopes.
calibration.numeric: Convex4-variable QP; SLSQP plus active KKT polish and linear-oracle gap<=1e-8, primal<=1e-10. No clipping. Failed certificate retained, no fake successful calibration.
calibration.labels: Use cutoff-specific frozen training metadata; stop strictly before outer Jan1, original labels and sources unchanged.

simulation.primary: Reuse exactly450 preceding data repetitions and q2 controls; fit onlywide83 (1350 forests), raw and parent-shrunk derivatives. Same pairing; newly exposed follow-up simulation, not a new independent confirmation.
simulation.true_recovery: Unchanged analytic population-marginal-product reference, amplitude projection and fullL2/RMS, structure detectionRMS>=.005 with .0025/.01 sensitivity; both causes365/730days, ensemble primary.
simulation.pairing: Exact same generated input/outcome hashes and company bootstrap multiplicities. Eligibility intentionally differs. mtry/cutpoint RNG rule unchanged; structures need not match.
simulation.validation: All train/test rows at both horizons;32 fixed probes all native times; explicit component sums on4 probes. Native leaf CIF certificate for all inputs. Same validation scope as preceding simulation.

enterprise.main: 24m termination, ensemblefirst;12m and recovery secondary. Save all seeds/raw. Annual and pooled AUC,AP,IPCW Brier,mean risk/incidence,Top20/25,calibration bins.
enterprise.uncertainty: 1000 paired company resamples stratified by test year; seed20261031; fixed predictions, common indices for every contrast. Conditional descriptive intervals, not complete training or selection uncertainty.
enterprise.validation: ALL train/test rows at ALL native times and12/24 endpoints, both causes; full main+pair sum, save/reload; max error1e-10. Same training product reference for model comparisons.

budget.pool: oliver+lemon;Slurm managed P/E/SMT affinity;NFS;no GPU or cross-node single fit

boundaries: No nonlinear mapping or probability clipping
Preserve withdrawn experiments and current reference
All actual failed tasks/negative results retained
